description:
##Let us be that picturesque background for those memories you're creating, where the natural beauty of the desert converges with the grace and power of magnificent horses. 

*please note photographer is not included. Guest must bring their own. We have great recommendations if needed (: 

##Important information: 
- Photo shoots are billed by the hour.
$250 for first hour 
$125 for every hour after that 
- Price covers booked guest, and 2 attendees. Any extra guests will be charged $10 per person.
- ***All attendees, including the photographer, must have a waiver signed. The link to the waiver is in your confirmation email.***

## Includes:
- 1 horse brought out for you 
- 1 staff member to assist you
- Access to pasture and horses, along with other areas. Goats and other smaller companions. 

##Additional Horse Add On Includes: 
- Choice of horse (we reserve the right to switch horses for safety reasons)
- Choice of brown saddle or no saddle
